history.summary: Freehold 1BR (463sqft) at Rezi 3Two, D14 Geylang/Dakota, at $748k / $1,616 PSF — small-ticket freehold near Dakota MRT with the batch's top score (735, on-frontier). Listing PSF essentially matches the $1,602 URA median, so it is fairly priced rather than cheap; 1BR is a niche, shoebox-investor product.
history.rating_rationale: $1,616 PSF vs $1,602 URA median = priced at market, no built-in discount. URA rate 2.13%/yr is honest (resale, no new-launch bias) but modest, and rests on only 11 txns. Freehold tenure and Paya Lebar Central proximity (D14 airbase-relocation catalyst) plus Dakota MRT 730m are genuine positives, and the small $748k ticket is liquid. But shoebox 1BR is a narrower exit pool and the appreciation history here is low-single-digit. Strong score reflects efficient yield, not appreciation.

history.summary: The dossier's -16.5% 'cheap' read is age/district-relative, not project-relative: at the project level this 1+study at S$1,616 psf is at/above the verified median (1+1 median ~S$1,541; 12-mo range S$1,527-1,600). Strong ~4.5% yield and twin-MRT access are the real draws; freehold-but-Geylang and full pricing cap it.
history.rating_rationale: Web-verified Rezi 3Two 1+1 median is ~S$1,541 psf with a 12-month band of S$1,527-1,600 (high S$1,659 in Oct 2024). The S$1,616 psf ask therefore sits at the top of/above the same-cohort range — i.e. full price, not a bargain — even though the dossier's age_adj of -16.5% (vs district new-launch peers) and psf_premium_vs_cohort of just +1.0% (6 txns) reflect fair-to-full at project level. Per v3.4 value leads and there isn't a project-level value edge here. Positives are concrete: ~4.5% gross yield (strong for a freehold 1BR) and a walkable spot between Aljunied (EWL) and Dakota (CCL). Geylang carries the usual stigma/financing/tenant-mix caveats. Freehold is not a forward edge. Net: a fairly-priced, well-yielding unit in a mixed location — Neutral.
